description: She wears a moss-green woven floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves, edged with gold-tan knotwork along the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, front opening and hem. A cream linen underdress shows down the skirt opening. Two round shoulder brooches and a round worked belt clasp ornament the gown. A dark green-blue plaid fringed shawl rests around the forearms, and brown leather shoes show beneath the skirt. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
